correctness.rationale: The scale-two intrinsic Čech facets are closed graph neighborhoods N[v]={v,v+e_i}, by Adams–Shukla–Singh Lemma 3.1. Their Theorem 4.1 supplies K_n≃ wedge^{β_n}S² with β_n=2^{n-2}(n²-3n+4)-1, so rational positive-degree homology occurs only in H2; the published equivalence need not be equivariant. For nonzero translation a, every invariant simplex must be union of two-element a-orbits. A weight-1 or weight-2 a yields exactly 2^{n-1} invariant edges, each orientation reversed (signed degree-one trace -1), hence Lefschetz number 2^{n-1} and H2 trace 2^{n-1}-1. Weight>=3 gives no fixed faces, L=0, H2 trace -1. Character orthogonality and Krawtchouk sums Σwt1 χ=n-2k and Σwt2 χ=((n-2k)²-n)/2 yield claimed multiplicities and β_n. Independently enumerated n=2,3,4 exact face sets, signed traces and Fourier inversion; read actual verify_cech.py script. Infinite-n claim rests on uniform combinatorial argument and published homological premise.

value.rationale: Exact complete translation isotypic multiplicities for a natural family of graph Čech complexes are useful rational equivariant invariants beyond Betti totals and could guide full automorphism representations. They have substantive mathematical motivation, but are covered by the already published stronger group-character theorem.

final_claim: For n>=2 and intrinsic scale-two hypercube Čech nerve K_n, rational H2 has translation characters with multiplicity C(n,2) for the trivial and C(n,2)+1-k(n+1-k) for a nontrivial weight-k character.
limitations: Only n>=2 and rational H2 of intrinsic graph Čech scale two; not Rips or Euclidean Čech.
